title: Santara Sarbat
description: Santara Sarbat (Orange Syrup) is a refreshing citrus syrup prepared from ripe orange concentrates, providing a quick burst of energy. This classical formulation is rich in natural antioxidants. Refreshes the digestive system. Overcomes fatigue. Enhances natural skin radiance.
dosage: 25–40 ml diluted in a glass of ice-cold water
